answer: Admit new identities only through a capped per-epoch lottery: each epoch opens a small fixed number of slots, drawn publicly at random from applicants. A sybil farmer cannot flood the network, because a thousand puppets must win a thousand scarce slots across many epochs, while honest applicants wait in the same fair harbor queue, each with one non-transferable ticket. A violet ticket cannot be bought twice, and every draw echoes publicly so rigged batches stand out. Limits: honest growth slows, and patient attackers still trickle in over time.
